notes: Your Kit's wake card grew up: a fourteen-day sleep strip (memories per day, a dot for each dream cycle), a one-line summary of the last session with a Resume button beside it, and chips that choose where new memories are stored.
Pick a knowledge area (or leave it on General) and optionally a project on the wake card; your Kit files everything it saves there for the rest of the session.
The recall card now leads with what was actually found: "recalled that <memory> and 6 others" instead of a bare count.
Resume now always points at the real last session, and every card speaks your Kit's own name, including when it is offline.
